claim: Replacing the MLP prediction head (FlattenHead) with a KANLinear head (B-spline basis, grid_size=5, spline_order=3) reduces MAE/RMSE on BIKE-Inflow relative to the frozen MLP baseline, under identical hyperparameters and seeds
hypothesis: H1 (mechanism): the learnable B-spline basis of KAN captures the non-linear mapping from the fused spatio-temporal features to the prediction target better than the fixed-activation MLP head; KAN heads have been identified as the highest-impact replacement position in time-series tasks.
notes: Single controlled variable vs baseline = prediction head type (MLP -> KANLinear). Gate fusion internals untouched. 3 seeds, identical everything else.
